labels.symptom: Contributor offers a redesigned app icon.
In the browser, plotting puts raw base64 PDF data in the command history instead of downloading a file.
labels.root_cause: The browser build has no file-delivery path for generated PDF output.

labels.symptom: On macOS, opening a document from Finder shows a 'cannot open files in this format' alert.
labels.root_cause: Only argv and dropped files are handled; the open-documents Apple Event and application:openURLs: are ignored.

labels.symptom: Auto-fit export renders the drawing into a tiny corner because the extents include far-off title blocks and stray entities.
labels.root_cause: The extents calculation unions all geometry, including distant outliers.

labels.symptom: Request for a new suite app that copies Revit.
Dynamic block parameters (grips, visibility states, lookups, stretch/flip) are not supported.
The Linux app icon has no scalable SVG version, only raster sizes.
labels.root_cause: The scalable hicolor SVG icon is missing from the app's assets.

labels.symptom: On Linux there is a noticeable delay between moving the mouse and the app responding.
labels.root_cause: This is probably the default high-throughput surface config, which queues frames.

labels.symptom: There are no blocks for solar panels, EV chargers, home batteries, heat pumps or rainwater tanks.
There are no RIBBON or RIBBONCLOSE commands.
Dragging a selection box from left to right doesn't select only the objects fully inside the box.
Copying lines from another drawing and pasting them at the same coordinates doesn't work.
DWG blocks display wrongly, DWG files are missing from the file picker, and closing the window doesn't ask to save changes.
Request for parametric 3D CAD modeling.
Windows Magnifier does not follow the mouse pointer inside the work area.
labels.root_cause: A custom-drawn cursor replaces the system pointer, so the Magnifier cannot track its position.

labels.symptom: The desktop app has no guided setup that finds the CLI and produces a working MCP configuration for an agent client.
labels.root_cause: No guided setup flow exists in the desktop UI.

labels.symptom: Desktop installs give no documented, reliable way to run the bundled CLI from scripts or agents without relying on PATH.
labels.root_cause: Windows, AppImage and Flatpak packages don't put the CLI on PATH, and macOS ships it as a separate download.

labels.symptom: The product name may conflict with an existing trademark.
A user asks for a new app that copies Fusion.
Plot style tables are ignored when plotting or exporting.
There is no parametric 3D CAD app or shared B-rep modelling kernel.
The Print command opens only a simple dialog instead of the full plot dialog.
Typing a command alias shows several matching commands and does not mark which one will actually run.
labels.root_cause: Command-line autocomplete does not rank or label the exact alias match first.

labels.symptom: Line segments after the first are invisible until the drawing command ends.
Clicking the Plot Preview toolbar button does nothing.
The output command is labelled Print rather than the standard CAD term Plot.
Named views, tiled viewports, MVIEW Restore and realtime/dynamic zoom are missing.
A dimension style can be deleted while a dimension inside a block still uses it.
labels.root_cause: The in-use check before deletion looks only at model-space dimensions, not dimensions inside blocks.

labels.symptom: After a text style is renamed, text inside blocks still refers to the old style name.
labels.root_cause: The rename does not update text references inside block definitions.

labels.symptom: Changing a block's rotation in the properties does not rotate its attribute text.
labels.root_cause: properties.set changes the reference's rotation without transforming its attributes.

labels.symptom: A deleted layer's viewport freeze or colour override is applied to a new layer created with the same name.
labels.root_cause: layer.delete does not clear the deleted layer's per-viewport overrides.

labels.symptom: After an exploded block insert, a second undo brings back an unexploded block reference.
labels.root_cause: The JSON exploded insert records two undo entries for a single operation.

labels.symptom: Setting an object to a linetype that is not loaded reports success and turns dashed lines solid.
labels.root_cause: properties.set does not check the linetype name against the loaded linetype table.

labels.symptom: Picking the same region twice for a solid or gradient fill creates a fill with no visible area.
labels.root_cause: Duplicate boundaries are not removed, so the even-odd fill cancels itself out.

labels.symptom: The Align Text Angle menu item fails even when a dimension is selected.
labels.root_cause: dimtedit.angle needs an angle parameter that the menu invocation cannot supply.

labels.symptom: The Quick Dimension menu item fails immediately with a missing-location error.
labels.root_cause: The bare command needs JSON arguments and does not prompt for the selection or the dimension-line location.

labels.symptom: Measuring the area of a partial ellipse reports the full ellipse's area and perimeter.
labels.root_cause: The area calculation ignores the elliptical arc's start and end parameters.

labels.symptom: Zoom extents, window selection and viewport plots cut off multileader text.
labels.root_cause: Multileader bounds stop at the text insertion point instead of including the rendered text.

labels.symptom: Clicking directly on a visible stroke of a pattern hatch does not select the hatch.
labels.root_cause: Point hit-testing does not check the hatch's pattern strokes.

labels.symptom: Plotting a layout with an explicit scale and fit-to-paper off still produces a 1:1 PDF.
labels.root_cause: Layout plotting ignores the numeric scale when fit is false.

labels.symptom: Choosing extents, display, limits or window as a layout plot area appears to work, but the plot always prints the whole sheet.
labels.root_cause: Layout PDF plotting ignores the plot area setting, and the setting is accepted without any warning.

labels.symptom: Automation clicks requested with the Shift modifier act like ordinary clicks when no real Shift key is held.
labels.root_cause: The control server's ui.click does not inject a modifier-change event, so the shift flag never reaches egui input.

labels.symptom: With the command line hidden, Escape does not cancel commands and typed command names do nothing.
labels.root_cause: Keyboard routing depends on the command line widget being shown.

labels.symptom: An uncommitted edit in a text field is thrown away when the window loses focus and regains it.
labels.root_cause: The field's pending text is reset to the stored value when window focus changes.

labels.symptom: Sending Escape through the control channel clears the selection but leaves a grip active, so the next click still edits the object.
labels.root_cause: The control channel's Escape handling does not reset grip state the way keyboard Escape does.

labels.symptom: In the web build the ?cpu URL flag does not switch to the CPU drawing path, and the GPU canvas is still used.
labels.root_cause: Web startup installs the custom GPU canvas without checking the cpu flag.

labels.symptom: Offsetting a full ellipse puts the copy on the opposite side from the one picked.
labels.root_cause: The side test for closed ellipses is inverted.

labels.symptom: Japanese file names and tab names show as squares, and long tab names cover the close button.
labels.root_cause: No CJK fallback font is loaded, and tab layout does not reserve space for the close button.

labels.symptom: MTEXT has no columns, bullets, tabs, fields or spell check, and can't be edited in place.
Typing the STYLE command with no arguments shows an error instead of opening the Text Style dialog.
labels.root_cause: The command metadata marks style as non-interactive with a required name, so there is no dialog fallback.

labels.symptom: The interface can't be switched to Simplified Chinese.
There is no opt-in way to back up, version or share documents on storage the user owns (NAS, Google Drive, OneDrive, S3 via rclone).
On Windows and Linux the window lacks the standard custom title bar and caption buttons, and there is no System Title Bar preference.
labels.root_cause: Window decoration handling not standardized to the shared custom title bar architecture.

labels.symptom: The macOS app shipped in the DMG fails strict codesign verification because of FinderInfo metadata.
labels.root_cause: The macOS packaging script leaves a com.apple.FinderInfo extended attribute on the signed app bundle.

labels.symptom: Large drawings freeze for over a second on each zoom or pan step.
labels.root_cause: Pattern hatches are expanded dash by dash at full resolution across the whole drawing, regardless of what is in view.

labels.symptom: Some PEDIT and SPLINEDIT options print 'not available yet', and closed splines ignore fit tolerance.
In exported PDFs the text cannot be selected, and there are no layers, multi-sheet output or hyperlinks.
labels.root_cause: The PDF writer draws text as stroked geometry and writes only one sheet, with no optional content groups.

labels.symptom: Opening a 10 MB AutoCAD 2010 DWG takes about two minutes, then fails with 'file too large' and shows an empty drawing.
On Windows the app crashes with a wgpu validation error while reconfiguring the window surface, losing open work.
labels.root_cause: No uncaptured wgpu error handler is installed, so GPU errors panic the process, and the unstable GL backend can be picked on Windows.
bug_markers: Handling wgpu errors as fatal by default
Failed to wait for GPU to come idle before reconfiguring the Surface

labels.symptom: DWG files saved by the app open in AutoCAD but AUDIT reports errors, including an unfixed table style object.
labels.root_cause: The DWG writer saves as AC1018 and writes table style objects that AutoCAD does not consider valid.

labels.symptom: Clicking the gear icon on a tool category header collapses the category instead of opening options.
labels.root_cause: The gear icon is painted with no click area of its own, so the whole header row only toggles collapse.

labels.symptom: Snap and grid spacing go back to defaults after a drawing is saved and reopened.
labels.root_cause: The DXF reader and writer ignore the $SNAPUNIT and $GRIDUNIT header variables.

labels.symptom: On Windows the app exits right after the window appears with 'Parent device is lost' because the DXC shader compiler DLLs are missing.
labels.root_cause: Windows packages do not ship dxcompiler.dll and dxil.dll, so wgpu's DX12 DXC pipeline compile fails and the device is lost.

labels.symptom: User asks why the app is written in Rust instead of C or C++.
There is no SketchUp-style live 3D modelling mode alongside the CAD layout.
Opened DXF drawings have all Z coordinates flattened to zero, so there is no 3D support.
labels.root_cause: Only 2D geometry is supported.

labels.symptom: The collapse arrow on the right-side panel doesn't hide the panel, while the left one works.
The PTYPE point style command is reported as unknown.
3D mouse devices cannot be used to navigate the canvas.
Clicking or dragging the ViewCube does not change the view angle.
The Attach command and some other commands are not implemented.
README explains how to install the app on Gentoo from a community overlay.
On Windows 11 with fractional display scaling, the window opens at the wrong size.
labels.root_cause: Stock winit 0.30.13 lacks the upstream #4341 fix for physical window size under DPI scaling.

labels.symptom: On Linux Wayland, text entry or IME composition breaks off when the compositor's capabilities change.
labels.root_cause: winit drops the Wayland text-input object when capabilities are updated.

labels.symptom: On Windows, the IME caret appears in the wrong position during composition, especially when typing Korean.
labels.root_cause: winit's Windows IME path does not carry the composition caret position through.

labels.symptom: On Windows, a window that should start hidden flashes into view while it is being maximized.
labels.root_cause: winit makes the window visible when it applies the maximized state.

labels.symptom: On Linux X11, the input method stops working after the input context is replaced.
labels.root_cause: winit leaves its focus handling bound to the old X11 input context.

labels.symptom: On macOS, text committed with an input method sometimes disappears and never reaches the field.
labels.root_cause: winit drops the pending IME commit when the marked text is cleared.

labels.symptom: On macOS, IME text can appear in the wrong place after focus moves.
labels.root_cause: winit applies delayed composition callbacks after focus or IME state has already changed.

labels.symptom: On macOS, emoji picked from the emoji picker never show up in text fields.
labels.root_cause: winit doesn't forward text inserted by the emoji picker to the app's event stream.

labels.symptom: On macOS, typing a space during Korean input inserts two spaces.
labels.root_cause: Both the native winit IME callback and the app's text handling insert the space.

labels.symptom: On macOS the first Korean key pressed after startup comes out as a raw jamo instead of starting composition.
labels.root_cause: winit's macOS backend does not route the first Apple Korean keystroke into IME composition.

labels.symptom: The command-line tool ignores or misreads unknown options and keeps running instead of stopping with an error.
labels.root_cause: CLI subcommands did not check their options before starting work.

labels.symptom: Polyline half-width gives half the intended width, and start/end widths produce a uniform band instead of a taper.
labels.root_cause: The interactive polyline command kept a single width value and stored half-width answers as the total width.

labels.symptom: Arcs with zero radius are added to the drawing instead of being rejected.
labels.root_cause: run_arc did not validate arcs in its center/radius and start/center/end forms.

labels.symptom: Some menu items do nothing, and automation calls for open or save pop up file pickers that block.
labels.root_cause: Command dispatch did not separate interactive invocations, which should open dialogs, from JSON calls, which should not.

labels.symptom: Drawing bounds leave out the width of polylines that have per-segment widths.
labels.root_cause: Polyline extents only padded the centre line by const_width and ignored start and end widths.

labels.symptom: On macOS the app icon in the Dock looks the wrong size while the app is running.
labels.root_cause: The window used the unpadded 256px icon on macOS instead of the padded 512px macOS icon.

labels.symptom: Setting DIMSCALE has no effect on dimensions created afterwards.
labels.root_cause: Header DIM* variables were never applied to new dimensions as style overrides.

labels.symptom: The macOS disk image opens as a plain white Finder window without a branded background or icon layout.
labels.root_cause: The DMG packaging had no background image or Finder layout settings.

labels.symptom: Layer transparency and descriptions are reset after saving and reopening a drawing.
labels.root_cause: The LAYER writer omitted the transparency and description xdata, and the reader ignored them.

labels.symptom: Attribute definition prompts are lost after saving and reopening.
labels.root_cause: The ATTDEF writer always wrote an empty group 3.

labels.symptom: Exploding a 3D polyline produces lines whose endpoints all have zero elevation.
labels.root_cause: EXPLODE built each segment from 2D points, which sets Z to 0.

labels.symptom: Setting a dimension parameter to an invalid value such as a negative distance or zero radius is accepted, and the constraint silently stops being enforced.
labels.root_cause: set_parameter committed the re-solved drawing without checking whether the change caused a constraint to be skipped as out of domain.

labels.symptom: Arc-length dimensions reopen from DXF as aligned dimensions that measure the chord.
labels.root_cause: The DXF writer saved arc-length dimensions as type 1 (aligned) and did not write the arc centre.

labels.symptom: A dimension override that sets both text and variables ignores the text.
labels.root_cause: run_override handled text only when it was the only key in the call.

labels.symptom: A polyline's elevation is reset to zero after saving and reopening.
labels.root_cause: The LWPOLYLINE writer did not write group 38.

labels.symptom: Typed angles for an elliptical arc put its endpoints in the wrong directions.
labels.root_cause: Typed angles were used directly as ellipse parameters instead of being converted with param_of.

labels.symptom: Zoom extents and picking miss justified single-line text.
labels.root_cause: The text bounds ignored justification offsets.

labels.symptom: Deleting a dimension that another dimension refers to breaks the remaining dimension.
labels.root_cause: delconstraint did not check whether surviving expressions still referred to the deleted parameter.

labels.symptom: A single automation call sometimes applies its change twice when the connection drops.
labels.root_cause: The bridge resent any request after a lost reply, including non-idempotent mutations.

labels.symptom: Wipeout objects disappear after the drawing is saved and reopened.
labels.root_cause: The DXF writer had no case for Wipeout entities.

labels.symptom: Joining objects deletes selected objects that are not part of the joined chain.
labels.root_cause: Join removed every selected handle instead of only the ones it consumed.

labels.symptom: Fence selection misses construction lines and rays that it crosses.
labels.root_cause: Infinite objects were left out of the candidates and filtered out by a bounds check.

labels.symptom: The angular dimension command rejects polyline and rectangle sides when you pick them.
labels.root_cause: DIMANGULAR accepted only LINE and ARC entities.

labels.symptom: Viewport frozen-layer lists are cleared after saving and reopening a drawing.
labels.root_cause: The viewport frozen-layer list was not written to the DXF file, and the reader always set it to empty.

labels.symptom: Changing a gradient hatch to a named pattern still shows a solid fill.
labels.root_cause: The gradient field was not cleared when a non-solid pattern was chosen.

labels.symptom: Moving a source object shifts a continued dimension's free origin, so the dimension shows the wrong length.
labels.root_cause: The rigid-carry step in assoc::recompute moved unattached p13 and p14 points.

labels.symptom: Dimension text rotation is lost after saving to DXF and reopening the file.
labels.root_cause: The DXF writer did not emit group 53 and wrote the block MTEXT with zero rotation.

labels.symptom: Multiline text created with a zero or negative height becomes a tiny dot after reopening.
labels.root_cause: The mtext command did not check that the height is positive.

labels.symptom: The area reported for a hatch wrongly includes the unfilled islands inside it.
labels.root_cause: The area of every boundary loop was summed without applying odd-parity subtraction.

labels.symptom: Some accepted spellings of automatic constraint types are silently ignored.
labels.root_cause: The raw names were stored instead of the canonical ones, so later matching failed.

labels.symptom: An ordinate dimension keeps showing its old value after the geometry it is attached to moves.
labels.root_cause: The rigid-move recompute also moved the ordinate's datum point along with the feature.

labels.symptom: On Wayland desktops, dragging files from the file manager onto the window shows a prohibited cursor and the drop does nothing.
labels.root_cause: winit 0.30 has no Wayland drag-and-drop, so the app has to run through XWayland to get file drops.

labels.symptom: No Flatpak release builds are published and AppImages cannot update themselves.
labels.root_cause: The release workflow lacked Flatpak jobs and AppImages had no embedded zsync update info.

labels.symptom: Gradient hatches become plain solid hatches after the drawing is saved and reopened.
labels.root_cause: The DXF writer never wrote the hatch gradient and the reader always set it to None; DWG saves at AC1015 also drop gradient fields.

labels.symptom: A hole drawn from separate lines is ignored by hatch, gradient and boundary fills.
labels.root_cause: Islands were detected only from single closed objects.

labels.symptom: Running the MCP command with --connect but no address silently starts a separate headless session.
labels.root_cause: The argument parser treated a missing --connect value as if the flag was absent and ignored unknown arguments.

labels.symptom: The first point of a line cannot snap tangent to a circle.
labels.root_cause: Tangent snaps need a base point, and the first point has none.

labels.symptom: Non-ASCII text in saved drawing files shows up garbled when the files are opened in other programs.
labels.root_cause: The DXF writer wrote raw UTF-8 while declaring an R2000 code-page file, instead of using \U+XXXX escapes.

labels.symptom: Images exported from the command line ignore zoom and pan and always show the full extents.
labels.root_cause: The CLI export never passed the session's view to the writer.

labels.symptom: An automated test passes even though undo removes an extra object.
labels.root_cause: The scripted TEXT command was not finished before undo ran, and the test did not check that the centre line survived.

labels.symptom: Closing a document with unsaved changes discards them without asking.
labels.root_cause: The close commands removed the document without checking whether it was dirty.

labels.symptom: CJK text shows as empty boxes when its font lacks those glyphs.
labels.root_cause: There was no per-character fallback to installed fonts, and the font scan skipped .ttc/.otc collections.

labels.symptom: Object transparency cannot be set, is not shown, and is lost on save.
labels.root_cause: properties.set ignored the transparency key, and the DXF reader and writer did not handle group 440.

labels.symptom: Opening a large DWG file takes minutes and uses a lot of memory, then fails with a misleading 'file too large' error.
labels.root_cause: The group-code cap was only checked after the whole DWG had been converted to DXF text and buffered, so the work and memory were spent before the error appeared.

labels.symptom: Selection commands run with nothing selected do nothing instead of asking you to select objects.
labels.root_cause: The commands ran on an empty selection without prompting.

labels.symptom: Running undo from a script or automation while a command is still active undoes the previous command and loses the active command's work.
labels.root_cause: Programmatic undo/redo did not end the running command first, and that command's undo step is only pushed when it finishes.

labels.symptom: The interface stays dark when the OS is in Light mode, and there is no Light or System theme.
labels.root_cause: The palette was hard-coded to dark.

labels.symptom: Several menu items do nothing when clicked.
labels.root_cause: The menus ran commands with no parameters, and their dialogs did not exist.

labels.symptom: Clicks on the command line, ViewCube and UCS icon go through to the drawing underneath.
labels.root_cause: The overlays had no widget that senses both clicks and drags, so egui's hit test kept the canvas hovered.

labels.symptom: Many controls in the Properties panel do nothing when clicked.
labels.root_cause: The controls were only painted and had no handlers.

labels.symptom: On Linux the on-canvas cursor lags behind the mouse.
labels.root_cause: On X11/XWayland the Vulkan swapchain's minimum image count makes the vsync queue two frames deep, and the canvas also requested a repaint every frame.

labels.symptom: The Windows installer never offers to create a desktop shortcut.
labels.root_cause: The MSI had no WixUI dialogs.

labels.symptom: The Import, Export, Batch Publish and Plot Preview buttons print 'unknown command'.
labels.root_cause: These commands were never registered.

labels.symptom: Screen magnifiers and recorders lose track of the mouse pointer over the canvas because the system cursor is hidden.
labels.root_cause: Asking for CursorIcon::None hides the OS cursor through winit's ShowCursor(FALSE).

labels.symptom: A rejected layer property change still applies some of the requested changes and adds an undo step.
labels.root_cause: Changes were applied to the live layer before validation ran.

labels.symptom: Deleting or purging a layer removes it even though objects inside a block still use it.
labels.root_cause: The in-use check ignored entities inside block definitions.

labels.symptom: The README Downloads section doesn't say where to get the app first and lists macOS builds before Windows.
An angular constraint over 180 degrees between two lines is accepted but is never satisfied.
labels.root_cause: The range check allowed up to 360 degrees for two-line angles.

labels.symptom: After a layer is renamed, objects in paper space and block definitions still point to the old layer name.
labels.root_cause: Rename re-pointed only model-space entities.

labels.symptom: Closing an inactive document that comes before the active one switches you to a different document.
labels.root_cause: After a document was removed, the active index was only clamped to the new length and not decremented.

labels.symptom: In the browser version, Save reports success and clears the unsaved marker but no file is downloaded.
labels.root_cause: On wasm the save path skipped the file write but still marked the document saved, and no download hook existed.

labels.symptom: Renaming a linetype makes dashed lines draw as solid.
labels.root_cause: Rename only changed the linetype table entry and left layer, object and current-linetype references on the old name.

labels.symptom: Editing commands change or delete objects on locked layers.
labels.root_cause: Several commands were missing the locked-layer check.

labels.symptom: Viewport layer colour overrides are lost after saving to DXF and reopening.
labels.root_cause: The VIEWPORT writer left out layer_colors and the reader always set them to empty.

labels.symptom: In the Save As dialog, a file name typed with a supported but unlisted extension is changed to another format.
labels.root_cause: The save dialog filter list omitted a format the app can write, and the macOS dialog accepts only listed extensions.

labels.symptom: In the browser version, File > Open does nothing and dropped files are ignored.
labels.root_cause: The web app was built without an open picker, and drop handling ran only on native builds.

labels.symptom: Docs refer to the renamed sibling app PrintCraft instead of PdfCraft.
labels.root_cause: Sibling app was renamed and docs were not updated.

labels.symptom: Picking a circle for an angular dimension is rejected.
labels.root_cause: The command accepted only lines and arcs.

labels.symptom: Print or Cmd/Ctrl+P seems to do nothing, and no print dialog appears.
labels.root_cause: The plot command ran with no parameters and its PDF output was discarded.

labels.symptom: On macOS the window title text is not vertically aligned with the traffic-light buttons.
labels.root_cause: The title was drawn 1 pt below the centre of the 28 pt title row, and long titles could run under the buttons.

labels.symptom: Saved layer states disappear after saving to DXF and reopening.
labels.root_cause: Layer states were never written to or read from DXF.

labels.symptom: The progress and parity docs are out of date.
Saving to DXF drops block descriptions and turns constant attribute definitions into variable ones.
labels.root_cause: The ATTDEF writer wrote only the invisible flag, and BLOCK group 4 was neither written nor read.

labels.symptom: The Open dialog's default filter leaves out some formats the app can open.
labels.root_cause: The file dialog filter listed only some of the supported extensions.

labels.symptom: Circles drawn through three points at large coordinates come out in the wrong place.
labels.root_cause: The circumcenter was computed from squares of absolute coordinates, which loses precision.

labels.symptom: Bounding boxes of rotated ellipses and elliptical arcs are not tight.
labels.root_cause: Bounds were taken from a tessellation rather than computed analytically.

labels.symptom: Area of curved polylines and of polygons far from the origin is measured inaccurately.
labels.root_cause: Areas were computed from tessellated curves and absolute coordinates, causing approximation error and floating-point cancellation.

labels.symptom: Long lines that pass just outside a circle are wrongly treated as tangent to it.
labels.root_cause: The quadratic-discriminant intersection lost floating-point precision.

labels.symptom: Saving to DXF and reopening loses entity thickness, point angle, hatch origin and background, and xref paths.
labels.root_cause: The DXF writer never wrote these groups and the reader misread polyface meshes.

labels.symptom: Saving to DXF and reopening loses linetype text, multileader styles, page setups, named views, UCSs and groups.
labels.root_cause: The DXF writer wrote these table and object items incompletely and the reader ignored them.

labels.symptom: Saving a drawing from another program drops raster images and unsupported entity types without any warning.
labels.root_cause: The DXF writer had no case for IMAGE or proxy entities, and the reader ignored IMAGEDEF.

labels.symptom: The interface can't be shown in Polish.
While drawing lines, new segments do not appear until the command ends.
labels.root_cause: The document revision was bumped only when a command finished, so the canvas did not rebuild for edits made while the command was running.

labels.symptom: Typing a transparent 'ZOOM or 'PAN during a command cancels that command instead of running inside it.
labels.root_cause: Session::start only nested transparent commands that had no prompt machine and cancelled the running command for all others.

labels.symptom: The ELLIPSE Rotation/Parameter and BREAK First point keywords are ignored, so the values typed after them are read the wrong way.
labels.root_cause: The command state machines listed the keywords but had no handling for them.

labels.symptom: Saving as DWG and reopening loses true colours, transparency, table styles, layout contents and viewport numbering.
labels.root_cause: The DXF-to-DWG conversion wrote R2000 DWG, which can't store those features, and viewport ids were renumbered.

labels.symptom: Typed selection modes W, C, F, WP and CP at the Select objects prompt are rejected as invalid selection.
labels.root_cause: The selection prompt preprocessor did not recognise the typed selection mode keywords.

labels.symptom: In scripts and command-line input, a trailing or double space is not treated as Enter, so commands wait at a prompt.
labels.root_cause: Scripts trimmed each line and the command line split on runs of whitespace, so the empty inputs were lost.

labels.symptom: STRETCH stops selecting after one window, ignores C, and Displacement does nothing.
labels.root_cause: STRETCH shared the MOVE prompt machine, which had no repeated selection or Displacement handling.

labels.symptom: The ARRAY command is missing, and the rectangular and polar array commands have no edit-option loop.
Choosing the Reference option in ROTATE does nothing and the values typed after it run as commands.
labels.root_cause: The ROTATE Reference keyword was a stub that echoed 'not available yet'.

labels.symptom: AREA's Object, Add and Subtract options and DIST's Multiple points option do nothing when chosen.
labels.root_cause: These keyword options were dropped without being handled.

labels.symptom: The TEXTEDIT prompt says "or or" and ignores its options, and MTEXT in scripts takes only one line.
labels.root_cause: The prompt message already ended in "or", the options had no handlers, and MTEXT read a single input as its whole contents.

labels.symptom: A closed spline has a corner at the seam, and some spline, polygon and circle prompt inputs are ignored.
labels.root_cause: Close appended the first fit point to an open clamped spline instead of building a periodic curve.

labels.symptom: UNDO doesn't ask for a count, and in scripts the number after it runs as a command.
labels.root_cause: UNDO undid one step at once, without prompting, and U was an alias of it.

labels.symptom: OFFSET Erase/Layer/Multiple/Undo and MOVE/COPY Displacement options are ignored.
labels.root_cause: Prompt keywords were accepted but not handled.

labels.symptom: Dimension and multileader prompt options are listed but ignored or do the wrong thing.
labels.root_cause: The interactive prompt machines did not apply the text, angle and leader options.

labels.symptom: Command-line INSERT has no X/Y scale prompts, so script values run as commands.
labels.root_cause: INSERT prompt machine had a single scale prompt and ignored Basepoint/Scale/Rotate.

labels.symptom: The Fillet and Chamfer options Trim, Multiple, Undo, Angle, Method and Polyline are listed but do nothing.
labels.root_cause: The command prompt machines accepted the keywords but did not handle them.

labels.symptom: Redefining a block with its own reference makes it nest itself and lose its geometry.
labels.root_cause: The block definition was not checked for cycles, and block names were compared case-sensitively.

labels.symptom: Viewports with a layer named PAPERVIEW disappear after reloading the drawing.
labels.root_cause: The marker check matched any xdata string instead of only the first one.

labels.symptom: Dashed lines look solid in layout viewports and plots.
labels.root_cause: The renderer ignored PSLTSCALE when drawing model space through viewports.

labels.symptom: Ctrl+P and the Print button seem to do nothing.
labels.root_cause: Without a path the PDF was built in memory and then dropped, and Ctrl+P was shown in the menu but not bound.

labels.symptom: The command-line layer command ends at once, and the rest of the script runs as unrelated commands.
labels.root_cause: Stripping the dash mapped -LAYER to the listing command, which had no prompt machine.

labels.symptom: Purge deletes everything unused without asking, and the rest of the line runs as commands.
labels.root_cause: Purge had no prompts or type parameters.

labels.symptom: Changing the point style has no visible effect, and points draw as tiny dots.
labels.root_cause: The renderer never read PDMODE or PDSIZE.

labels.symptom: RENAME has no command-line form and cannot rename blocks.
labels.root_cause: Only a JSON form existed and block table rename was unsupported.

labels.symptom: Opening a small file with nested or self-referencing blocks hangs the app and memory keeps growing.
labels.root_cause: Block expansion was bounded only in depth, not in the total number of copies.

labels.symptom: A spline created with a very high degree through automation hangs the app.
labels.root_cause: The JSON spline path did not clamp the degree to 1..10.

labels.symptom: The Reference option of the scale command is not available.
Debug builds panic when exporting an image or screenshot if a small point lands at certain sub-pixel positions.
labels.root_cause: tiny-skia's Pixmap::fill_rect anti-aliased filler hits a debug_assert for rects narrower than two pixels spanning adjacent pixels.

labels.symptom: Mirrored blocks, hatches and texts from DXF files appear on the wrong side of the drawing.
labels.root_cause: The DXF reader applied the OCS transform for extrusion (0,0,-1) only to a few entity types.

labels.symptom: The Blocks window lists block names but gives no way to use them.
Editing block attributes from the command line fails with a 'handle is required' error, and lowercase tags are silently ignored.
labels.root_cause: There was no prompt sequence for ATTEDIT, and attribute tags were matched case-sensitively.

labels.symptom: Chained dimensions with many points freeze the app for seconds.
labels.root_cause: Each new dimension scanned the whole space for snaps, which made the chain quadratic.

labels.symptom: There is no command to change attribute display or to sync attributes, and the display ignores ATTMODE.
labels.root_cause: The ATTDISP and ATTSYNC commands were not implemented, and the renderer ignored ATTMODE.

labels.symptom: A panic inside a command's start, prompt or preview step crashes the whole app and loses the open document.
labels.root_cause: Only execute and input ran under catch_unwind; the factory, begin, prompt and preview steps were not guarded.

labels.symptom: Near-white and near-black colours flip with the background, not just colour 7.
labels.root_cause: display_rgb flipped colours by luminance rather than only ACI 7.

labels.symptom: Opened drawings show a tiny plan in a huge empty canvas.
labels.root_cause: Extents included rays, missing/empty blocks and hidden block geometry.

labels.symptom: Lines with the Default lineweight always draw at 0.25 mm, whatever LWDEFAULT is set to.
labels.root_cause: The renderer's resolve function hard-coded 0.25 mm for Default.

labels.symptom: The layer merge and layer delete commands are unknown, which stops scripts.
labels.root_cause: LAYMRG and LAYDEL were not registered.

labels.symptom: Save As always suggests DXF for new drawings.
labels.root_cause: No preference for the default save format.

labels.symptom: Dashed linetypes look continuous in metric drawings because their dash lengths are in inches.
labels.root_cause: The linetype library is defined in inches and was loaded without scaling into metric drawings.

labels.symptom: The About window has no Contributors or Models tabs listing who contributed.
Writing a block to a file by name ignores the chosen base point.
labels.root_cause: run_wblock used the block's own base point and ignored the base parameter.

labels.symptom: Hatch island styles, background colours, gradients and custom pattern definitions are ignored when drawing or lost when saving.
labels.root_cause: The renderer used odd-parity flat fills only, and the DXF reader skipped pattern definition groups.

labels.symptom: Offsetting a closed spline creates an open spline.
labels.root_cause: The offset copy was rebuilt with open fit-point interpolation instead of the closed (periodic) one.

labels.symptom: Wipeouts don't hide objects behind them on screen or in exports.
labels.root_cause: Wipeouts were rendered only as an outline polygon.

labels.symptom: Wide polylines are drawn solid, ignoring their linetype.
labels.root_cause: Wide band fill never consulted the linetype.

labels.symptom: On some Windows machines the app crashes at startup with no window and no error message.
labels.root_cause: The default wgpu instance turns on the OpenGL backend on Windows, and creating it can crash inside the GPU vendor's OpenGL driver.

labels.symptom: The command-line block command turns the selection into a block reference instead of erasing it, and it redefines an existing block without asking.
labels.root_cause: -BLOCK was only an alias of BLOCK, and the leading dash was stripped, so it always converted the selection and never asked before redefining.

labels.symptom: Arabic, Persian or Urdu text appears as disconnected letters in reverse order, or as missing-glyph boxes.
labels.root_cause: Text was placed one glyph per code point, left to right, with no bidi or Arabic shaping, and font fallback ran out of its budget on CJK fonts.

labels.symptom: Text in complex linetypes is never drawn, only the dashes.
labels.root_cause: Renderer treated text elements as part of the gap.

labels.symptom: Object snaps ignore geometry inside block references.
labels.root_cause: osnap used prims() which returns only the insertion point for INSERTs.

labels.symptom: Dimensions ignore viewport layer colours, leader arrows are the wrong size, and attributes use the wrong colour.
labels.root_cause: The renderer resolved these properties differently from other entities.

labels.symptom: Builds that claim to bundle extra fonts embed none, so CJK or Arabic text shows as missing-glyph boxes, especially on the web.
labels.root_cause: No build script read CRAFT_FONTS_DIR, even though packaging shipped the fonts' licences.

labels.symptom: With several objects selected, dragging a grip edits only the clicked object instead of the whole selection.
labels.root_cause: The grip edit passed only the clicked object's handle and the stretch path edited a single object.

labels.symptom: Nearest object snap picks a circle over a closer object depending on drawing order.
labels.root_cause: The circle's nearest point replaced the best candidate without a distance comparison.

labels.symptom: Typed angles ignore the drawing's angle base, direction and units.
labels.root_cause: parse_angle always read a bare number as counterclockwise decimal degrees.

labels.symptom: Save As to an image or PDF format renames the document and clears unsaved changes, so closing does not prompt and work can be lost.
labels.root_cause: The save commit treated an export to a non-native format as a save of the document.

labels.symptom: An automation command given a malformed object ID acts on the current selection instead of failing.
labels.root_cause: The target parser fell back to the selection or dropped entries when the given IDs could not be parsed.

labels.symptom: Object snaps on elliptical arcs and splines are missing or land off the arc.
labels.root_cause: The snap code only handled lines, circles and circular arcs for these snap modes.

labels.symptom: Automation tool calls with malformed arguments are guessed at instead of rejected, and unknown tools don't return protocol errors.
labels.root_cause: The MCP server did not check arguments against the tool's input schema or return JSON-RPC -32602 errors.

labels.symptom: Dimensions offer no snaps, justified text snaps at the wrong point, grid snap ignores its base and angle, and hatches snap when they should not.
labels.root_cause: The snap code did not handle these entity types and system variables.

labels.symptom: Edits can overflow to infinite coordinates, and saving then moves the object to the origin.
labels.root_cause: Only command inputs were checked for being finite, not the results.

labels.symptom: -INSERT cannot insert a block exploded (*NAME) or insert a drawing file.
Draw commands sent as JSON accept negative sizes and coincident points and report success.
labels.root_cause: Parameters were silently clamped or made absolute instead of being validated.

labels.symptom: Top-, middle- and bottom-left text from DXF files is drawn and picked one offset away from where it should be.
labels.root_cause: Left-justified text was placed from group 10 instead of the group 11 alignment point.

labels.symptom: A control request that times out still runs later, so a client that retries applies the change twice.
labels.root_cause: The control server timed out without removing the request from the app's queue.

labels.symptom: Some drawing settings reset to 0 after saving and reopening.
labels.root_cause: The DWG bridge's DXF writer leaves these header variables out, and the snap base and angle were never written to or read from the VPORT record.

labels.symptom: The headless automation backend and the running app give different replies to the same control requests.
labels.root_cause: The two backends built their replies separately with different fields.

labels.symptom: Angle prompts ignore the drawing's angle unit, base and direction settings.
labels.root_cause: These prompts still used units::parse_angle, which always reads decimal degrees counterclockwise.

labels.symptom: Ctrl/Cmd+C, X and V keyboard shortcuts do nothing, and only the Edit menu works.
labels.root_cause: egui delivers copy, cut and paste as Copy/Cut/Paste events rather than key presses, so the shortcut table never sees them.

labels.symptom: Quick dimensioning over many objects takes a very long time.
labels.root_cause: Each new dimension rescanned the whole drawing for associations, which is quadratic.

labels.symptom: A block attribute's own layer, colour, linetype and lineweight are lost on DXF load and save.
labels.root_cause: The attribute entity had no fields for its own properties.

labels.symptom: The interface is only available in English with no language selector; Ukrainian is not offered.
labels.root_cause: No localization layer or Ukrainian catalog existed.

labels.symptom: An automation command-line Enter that is refused gives different replies headless and in the app, and the app drops the error.
labels.root_cause: The cmdline.key handlers didn't echo refused input or return output/error like cmdline.input.

labels.symptom: With the theme set to follow the system, later OS light/dark changes are ignored until the app restarts.
labels.root_cause: Passing the resolved concrete theme to egui pins the native window appearance, so winit stops sending ThemeChanged.

labels.symptom: MLEADER forgets its placement order and options for the next run.
labels.root_cause: Options lived only in the running command, not in the session's last-used state.

labels.symptom: Baseline dimensions overlap when the drawing is scaled, or all land on one line.
labels.root_cause: Spacing read DIMDLI and DIMSCALE from the bare style, ignoring overrides and the DIMSCALE 0 fallback.

labels.symptom: Exploded dimension text and saved DXF dimension blocks have the wrong text height and angle.
labels.root_cause: Text height was computed from bare style values instead of the renderer's dimension geometry.

labels.symptom: The local CI gate fails at the clippy step on the current stable Rust toolchain.
labels.root_cause: New clippy lints on stable Rust, which the workflows always use, deny existing code (here an always-true assert).

labels.symptom: ZOOM inside a layout viewport fits to the window instead of the viewport, and nXP acts like nX.
labels.root_cause: ZOOM always used the window view rather than the active viewport's view.

labels.symptom: After undoing a layout rename or a new layout, the tab is blank and commands fail with 'no such space'.
labels.root_cause: Undo and redo swapped the drawing but left the session's current layout unchanged.

labels.symptom: Dimension tolerances and alternate units are rounded by the primary rounding increment, and angular dimensions show the linear suffix.
labels.root_cause: The tolerance and alternate-unit formats were copied from the primary format, and DIMPOST was also applied to angular dimensions.

labels.symptom: Angular dimensions draw the extension line on the wrong leg, and radius dimensions draw the centre mark when the dimension line is inside the circle.
labels.root_cause: Arc ends were not paired with the correct legs when the arc direction swapped, and the centre mark was drawn without checking whether the dimension line was inside.

labels.symptom: Running UNITS or SETVAR from the command line appears to do nothing.
labels.root_cause: The commands had no interactive form, so they ran with empty parameters.

labels.symptom: Typing LAYOUT at the command line shows no prompts, so its options run as other commands.
labels.root_cause: The typed command had no interactive prompt form.

labels.symptom: DIMTEDIT typed at the command line or run from a script fails with 'select dimensions'.
labels.root_cause: DIMTEDIT had no interactive prompt machine and ran the JSON form at once, with nothing selected.

labels.symptom: Small intersecting circles are reported as tangent or not intersecting, and very large circles overflow.
labels.root_cause: Fixed absolute tolerances and unscaled squared radii were used.

labels.symptom: Hatch and boundary detection fail on geometry far from the origin.
labels.root_cause: Absolute coordinates were quantized to i64 and saturated, so distinct vertices merged.

labels.symptom: Typing VPLAYER at the command line shows no prompts, so its options run as other commands.
labels.root_cause: The typed command had no interactive prompt form.

labels.symptom: Radius and diameter dimension text is always drawn outside the circle, even when the location picked is inside it.
labels.root_cause: Only the direction of the picked location was used, never its distance from the centre.

labels.symptom: ZOOM Center, Scale and Dynamic zoom to extents instead of prompting, and All/Extents in paper space fit the model limits.
labels.root_cause: ZOOM option handling lacked prompts and mis-parsed scale factors.

labels.symptom: The dimension suffix is missing from tolerance values.
labels.root_cause: linear_text added the DIMPOST suffix only to the main measurement.

labels.symptom: A layout viewport on a frozen layer still shows its contents.
labels.root_cause: The frozen check hid only the viewport's border.

labels.symptom: Geometry gives wrong results with very large coordinates.
labels.root_cause: Squaring large floats overflowed in distance, length and midpoint math.

labels.symptom: A crossing selection drawn inside a filled solid doesn't select it.
labels.root_cause: Selection tested only polygon boundaries, not containment.

labels.symptom: FROM, M2P, point filters and the angle override at point prompts are rejected as invalid input.
labels.root_cause: There was no point-modifier layer.

labels.symptom: TRIM and EXTEND options answer 'not available yet'.
labels.root_cause: The options were stubs.

labels.symptom: Object snap tracking does nothing, and the Extension, Parallel and Apparent Intersection snaps don't work.
labels.root_cause: Tracking wasn't implemented, and those snap modes never produced a point.

labels.symptom: PLINE arc-mode options print 'not available yet', and XLINE offset always uses the polyline's first segment.
labels.root_cause: The options were stubs, and XLINE ignored which segment was picked.

labels.symptom: Typed object snap overrides like END or MID at point prompts are not recognised, and there is no snap menu or Tab cycling.
labels.root_cause: Point prompts had no snap-override layer.

labels.symptom: Damaged drawings with broken internal references can't be checked or repaired.
labels.root_cause: No audit or recover functionality existed.

labels.symptom: Plots and layouts ignore the plot style table, so sheets can't print monochrome or grayscale.
labels.root_cause: The stored plot style table was never applied during rendering or export.

labels.symptom: Spline Knots, Tangency, Tolerance and Object options answer 'not available yet'.
labels.root_cause: The options were stubbed.

labels.symptom: Multiline text options such as Height, Justify and Rotation answer 'not available yet'.
labels.root_cause: The options were stubbed.

labels.symptom: Unsaved work is lost when the app or the machine crashes, because there is no autosave or recovery.
labels.root_cause: There was no autosave or crash recovery.

labels.symptom: Named plot styles can't be set, managed or saved, and DXF files drop them.
Multileader spline leaders, no-leader content and block content options answer 'not available yet'.
labels.root_cause: The options were stubbed.

labels.symptom: There is no automated sweep that runs every command to check for panics or prompts that never end.
There is no way to create, edit or remove object groups, and erased objects leave stale entries in their groups.
labels.root_cause: Groups existed in the drawing model but had no commands, and erasing a member did not update its group.

labels.symptom: No Linux riscv64 release download is offered.
labels.root_cause: The release workflow had no riscv64 job.

labels.symptom: Clicking a member of a group selects only that object instead of the whole group.
labels.root_cause: There was no PICKSTYLE group selection and no -GROUP command.

labels.symptom: Drawings can only be saved as one fixed DXF/DWG version, and binary DXF cannot be written.
labels.root_cause: The writer was hard-coded to R2000 ASCII DXF and AC1018 DWG.

labels.symptom: Geometric tolerance frames can't be drawn, and the ones in opened files aren't shown and are lost on save.
labels.root_cause: There was no tolerance entity type, so these entities were kept only as unknown data.

labels.symptom: Linux packages ship the app icon only as fixed-size PNGs, with no scalable SVG icon.
labels.root_cause: No scalable SVG icon in the hicolor assets directory.

labels.symptom: Drawings can only be saved in one old format version and never as binary DXF.
There is no select-similar command and no way to isolate or hide individual objects.
Hot-grip options like Base point, Copy, Undo and Reference are shown at the prompt but typing them does nothing, and only one grip can be hot.
labels.root_cause: Hot-grip editing lived only in the UI and ignored the typed options.

labels.symptom: The Select objects prompt lacks BOX, AUto, SIngle, Multiple, Group and Undo keywords.
Polyline, line and arc grips only stretch, with no add/remove vertex, lengthen or radius options.
The block attribute manager only lists attribute definitions and cannot edit, remove or reorder them.
There is no temporary tracking point or tracking modifier at point prompts.
Draw order only supports front/back, and DXF draw order stored in a sort table is ignored on open.
There is no way to extract block and attribute data to a list, CSV file or table.
Typing the match-properties command fails because it has no interactive source/destination picker or Settings.
In a script, a keyword followed by a value on the same line is read as one value, and the command quietly draws nothing.
labels.root_cause: Text prompts that have keywords received the rest of the script line as one string instead of splitting it on spaces.

labels.symptom: There is no PolarSnap, relative polar angles do nothing, and Extension tracking ignores ellipse and spline ends.
Removing duplicate objects only deletes exact copies and ignores tolerance, overlapping lines, arcs and polylines.
Moving, stretching or scaling a hatch boundary leaves the associative hatch behind, and the link is lost on save to DXF.
labels.root_cause: Hatches did not record their boundary source objects and nothing re-traced them after edits; DXF loops were written with 97 0.

labels.symptom: Arrays are only plain copies; associative, levels and polar rows are not available.
Panels can now be docked, grouped and floated with shared layouts saved in workspaces.
Hatching lacks gap tolerance, origin, separate hatches, island style and full HATCHEDIT options.
Layout viewports can only be rectangles, and clipped or turned-off viewports lose their state in DXF.
Opening a resizable dialog makes its window grow taller every frame until it fills the screen.
labels.root_cause: A vertical separator in a row with no height limit takes all the height the resizable egui::Window offers.

labels.symptom: Associative arrays cannot be edited after creation.
There is no status bar control to view or set a layout viewport's scale or lock.
UNDO options Mark, Back, BEgin, End, Auto and Control do not work.
Multileaders are broken into loose leader and text pieces when saved and reopened as DXF.
System variables used by commands are reported unknown by GETVAR and accepted unchecked by SETVAR.
Extend, join and lengthen refuse elliptical arcs and splines.
Closing the window or quitting discards unsaved changes without asking to save.
labels.root_cause: The close request was not intercepted to check for unsaved documents.

labels.symptom: Filleting elliptical arcs or splines is refused.
bug_markers: Fillet works on lines, arcs and circles

labels.symptom: Annotative objects never scale with the annotation scale.
Filleting or chamfering two segments of a polyline fails with an error.
labels.root_cause: FILLET and CHAMFER only accepted a polyline as a whole.

labels.symptom: There are no named views, realtime or dynamic zoom, or a setting for the zoom step.
The model view can't be split into tiled viewports and viewport configurations can't be saved.
Annotation scales and the scale list are lost when a drawing is saved.
labels.root_cause: The writer did not write the annotation scale data.

labels.symptom: Each reopen-and-save adds unused dimension blocks and changes object handles, so the file keeps growing.
labels.root_cause: The writer gave dimensions new block names while keeping the old blocks, and the handle seed was offset again on every save.

labels.symptom: A host page that embeds the web app can't open files in it or receive its saves; saves become browser downloads.
Older drawings in CJK, Cyrillic or Central European encodings open with garbled text and layer names.
labels.root_cause: The reader decoded every file as UTF-8 with a Latin-1 fallback and ignored the declared code page.

labels.symptom: Dimension style variables for fit, text movement and linetypes are missing and ignored.
labels.root_cause: Only about half of the DIMSTYLE variables were modelled.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking during a command can only mean Enter, so the prompt's options and snap overrides can't be reached with the mouse.
labels.root_cause: The canvas had a single generic context menu.

labels.symptom: Multilines are drawn as two loose polylines with no style and cannot be edited as one object.
labels.root_cause: There was no multiline entity or multiline style in the drawing model.

labels.symptom: Right-clicking the command line, document tabs or palettes does nothing.
labels.root_cause: No context menus were set up for these UI areas.

labels.symptom: The render tool, when bridged to the running app, returns byte counts instead of an image and ignores fit, so it can return a blank image.
labels.root_cause: The desktop ui.render control handler did not return pngBase64 and always rendered the current view.

labels.symptom: Angular dimensions in degrees/minutes/seconds show one unit too low at whole-degree or minute precision, e.g. 45.75° shown as 45°.
labels.root_cause: The angle was rounded to whole seconds and the hidden minutes or seconds were then cut off, instead of rounding at the unit shown.

labels.symptom: HELIX makes a 3D polyline instead of a helix object.
There are no jogged, broken, oblique or inspection dimensions, and no DIMEDIT command.
Dynamic Input has no keyword options menu, and some object snaps are missing.
QDIM only makes continuous dimensions.
REGION makes polylines; there are no region objects, boolean operations or MASSPROP.
While stretching a grip you can't type a length, angle or radius.
The interface can't be shown in Traditional Chinese.
Referenced drawings are never loaded or drawn, and xrefs can't be attached, reloaded or bound.
There is no preferences dialog, and most settings reset on every launch.
labels.root_cause: No user profile or options dialog stored the settings.

labels.symptom: There is no External References palette for managing xrefs.
The interface cannot be shown in Brazilian Portuguese, and plural forms follow another language's rule.
labels.root_cause: There was no pt-BR catalog, and the plural rule was hardcoded for one language.

labels.symptom: Menus and tooltips show macOS ⌘ and ⇧ shortcut symbols on Windows, Linux and the web.
labels.root_cause: Shortcut labels were hard-coded with macOS symbols instead of being chosen by the runtime OS.

labels.symptom: Opening and saving another program's DXF file drops unknown entities, xdata and dictionaries.
labels.root_cause: The DXF reader read unmodelled data as Unknown and the writer never wrote it back.

labels.symptom: Multiline text ignores paragraph indents, tabs and lists, and has no columns.
Tables have no cell styles or formulas, and there is no way to export them.
Imported DXF hatches lose full-circle and spline boundaries, and clockwise ellipse edges fill the wrong side.
labels.root_cause: The DXF hatch edge reader mishandled full-turn arcs, spline group order and the ellipse clockwise flag.

labels.symptom: The constraint solver has no degrees-of-freedom report, no G2 smooth, and no ellipse, spline or block constraints.
Text field codes show as raw codes and there is no spell check.
Tables can't be broken into parts or take their data from linked CSV files.
Constraints are not inferred while drawing, and the canvas doesn't show how constrained the geometry is.
Cannot load custom linetype or hatch pattern files.
labels.root_cause: No parser for user .lin and .pat files.

labels.symptom: Polyline vertex editing and spline editing options say "not available yet".
labels.root_cause: PEDIT/SPLINEDIT options were unimplemented and closed-spline fit tolerance was ignored.

labels.symptom: Some spline edit options print "not available yet".
labels.root_cause: The Join, Add vertex and Elevate order options were not implemented.

labels.symptom: Isometric drafting toggle does nothing; no isometric snap, grid or isoplane switching.
labels.root_cause: The ISODRAFT flag was never read and isometric snap was not implemented.

labels.symptom: Cannot start a drawing from a template, save as template or use a custom command alias file.
labels.root_cause: DWT templates and .pgp alias files were not supported.

labels.symptom: COUNT misses block references that are nested, in layouts or in a selection.
labels.root_cause: COUNT only counted top-level model-space references.

labels.symptom: Plots ignore line end, join and fill styles from plot style tables.
labels.root_cause: Plot style end/join/fill values were stored but never applied when plotting.

labels.symptom: Exported PDFs flatten the layers, hold only one sheet per file and lose hyperlinks.
The command-line tool panics with exit code 101 when its output is piped into a command that closes early, such as head.
labels.root_cause: println! panics on a broken pipe when stdout is closed.

labels.symptom: There is no QuickCalc palette and no unit conversion in the calculator.
Users cannot define plotter devices with their own paper sizes and printable areas.
Text in exported PDFs cannot be selected, searched or copied because it is drawn as outlines.
labels.root_cause: The PDF writer drew glyphs as filled outlines instead of embedding font subsets.

labels.symptom: There is no way to compare two drawings and step through their differences.
The interface can't be shown in German.
Drawing output is labelled Print instead of the CAD term Plot.
SETVAR rejects point objects for point variables, even the values GETVAR itself returns.
labels.root_cause: The generic path converted only JSON arrays to points, not objects.

labels.symptom: Setting the current layer to a numeric name like 10 puts new objects on layer 0.
labels.root_cause: sysvars::set turned numeric-looking text into numbers even for text variables.

labels.symptom: The Dimension Space menu action fails right away with 'base dimension is required'.
labels.root_cause: DIMSPACE had no interactive prompt machine.

labels.symptom: Renaming a dimension style leaves dimensions inside blocks pointing at the old name.
labels.root_cause: dims_using walked only model space and the layouts, not block definitions.

labels.symptom: Changing a block's scale in Properties leaves its attribute text at the old position and height.
labels.root_cause: properties.set updated the scale without transforming the attached attributes.

labels.symptom: A two-finger trackpad swipe zooms the canvas instead of panning it.
labels.root_cause: Every scroll event was treated as zoom, whatever the device's scroll units.

labels.symptom: Setting a malformed lineweight reports success and replaces it with 0.25 mm.
labels.root_cause: properties.set fell back to 0.25 when it could not parse the lineweight string.

labels.symptom: Quick Dimension from the menu fails at once with a missing-location error.
labels.root_cause: qdim had no interactive prompt machine, so it ran with null parameters.

labels.symptom: The Align Text > Angle menu entry fails with a missing-parameter error instead of asking for the angle.
labels.root_cause: dimtedit.angle had no interactive prompt form, so it ran with null parameters.

labels.symptom: Picking the same region twice for a solid or gradient hatch produces an empty fill.
labels.root_cause: Duplicate boundary loops cancel out under even-odd filling.

labels.symptom: Setting an object's linetype to a name that is not loaded succeeds and the line draws solid.
labels.root_cause: properties.set did not check the linetype against the loaded linetype table.

labels.symptom: Inserting an exploded block creates two undo steps, and the second Undo brings back a block reference.
labels.root_cause: Exploded INSERT ran EXPLODE through Session::execute, which recorded its own undo snapshot.

labels.symptom: After deleting a layer and creating a new one with the same name, the new layer's geometry is hidden or plotted in the old colour in layout viewports.
labels.root_cause: layer.delete did not remove the deleted layer from viewport freeze lists and colour overrides.

labels.symptom: Changing a block reference's rotation in Properties leaves its attribute text unrotated.
labels.root_cause: The rotation property setter did not transform the attributes.

labels.symptom: Renaming a text style leaves text inside blocks pointing at the old name.
labels.root_cause: The rename skipped block definitions and multileader text.

labels.symptom: A dimension style can be deleted while a dimension inside a block still uses it.
labels.root_cause: The in-use check only looked at model space and layouts, not block definitions.

labels.symptom: Typing the text style command with no arguments shows an error instead of opening its dialog.
labels.root_cause: The command had no interactive dialog fallback and required a name parameter.

labels.symptom: Offsetting a full ellipse puts the copy on the side opposite the picked point.
labels.root_cause: The offset distance sign was reversed for counter-clockwise ellipse tessellation.

labels.symptom: The documented ?cpu URL flag does not switch the web build to the CPU canvas.
labels.root_cause: Web startup never read the flag and always installed the GPU canvas.

labels.symptom: Sending Escape through the automation interface leaves a clicked grip active.
labels.root_cause: The control Escape path only called the session cancel and did not clear the hot grip.

labels.symptom: Text typed but not yet committed in an input field is lost when the app window loses focus and regains it.
labels.root_cause: The field used Response::has_focus, which is false while the OS window is unfocused, instead of Memory::has_focus.

labels.symptom: With the command line hidden, Escape no longer cancels a command and typed commands do nothing.
labels.root_cause: The keyboard handler only ran inside the command line's draw function, which is skipped when the command line is hidden.

labels.symptom: Synthetic clicks or keys sent through the automation interface with Shift or other modifiers act as unmodified input.
labels.root_cause: Injected events carried modifiers, but egui's live modifier state only changes on Event::ModifiersChanged, which was never sent.

labels.symptom: Page Setup accepts plot areas that the layout plot then silently ignores.
labels.root_cause: Layout plotting always prints the whole sheet, but the command accepted other plot-area values without warning.
fixed_markers: is not available yet; layouts plot the whole sheet

labels.symptom: Plotting a layout with an explicit scale and fitting turned off prints at 1:1.
labels.root_cause: The non-fitted layout paper mapping used a hard-coded scale of 1.0.

labels.symptom: Clicking on a visible pattern hatch stroke does not select the hatch.
labels.root_cause: Hit testing used only the hatch's boundary segments and not its pattern strokes.

labels.symptom: No pointer input boxes beside the cursor when a command asks for a point.
Zoom extents, window selection and viewports clip or ignore multileader text.
labels.root_cause: Multileader bounds left out the text box.

labels.symptom: Measuring the area of an open elliptical arc reports the full ellipse's area and perimeter.
labels.root_cause: Area calculation ignored the ellipse's start and end span.

labels.symptom: On Windows, especially with Intel graphics, the app crashes with a wgpu validation error when reconfiguring the surface while loading a file or resizing the window.
labels.root_cause: No uncaptured-error handler was registered on the wgpu device, so its errors were fatal, and the unstable GL backend could still be forced on Windows.
bug_markers: Handling wgpu errors as fatal by default

labels.symptom: CI workflows are duplicated in every repo and raise Node 20 deprecation warnings.
Releases are not versioned and drafted automatically.
The interface cannot be shown in Spanish.
On Windows the app fails to start with DirectX 12.
labels.root_cause: Missing or mismatched dxcompiler.dll and dxil.dll runtimes break the default DXC shader compiler.

labels.symptom: Snap and grid spacing reset to defaults after saving and reopening a DXF drawing.
labels.root_cause: SNAPUNIT/GRIDUNIT sysvars were never read from or written to the DXF header or active VPORT.

labels.symptom: The brand license text has a grammar error: it uses "made" where it should say "makes".
labels.root_cause: A past-tense verb was used in a present-tense list.

labels.symptom: Measure Distance does not snap to endpoints or intersections.
labels.root_cause: Snapping did not query model geometry seen through layout viewports.

labels.symptom: The offset command does not work normally and shows no preview while in use.
labels.root_cause: Two-click distances were not handled and grid snap moved object-selection clicks.

labels.symptom: The roadmap is updated.
Linux users have no Flatpak repository to install and update the app from.
labels.root_cause: Releases ship only standalone Flatpak bundles with no hosted OSTree repository.

labels.symptom: Clicking the gear icon on a tool category header collapses the category instead of opening its options.
labels.root_cause: The gear icon was only drawn on the header and had no click area of its own.

labels.symptom: A constraint inference test fails on main after arrays became associative by default.
labels.root_cause: The test expected separate copies from ARRAYRECT, but it now creates one associative block reference.

labels.symptom: Press-and-drag selection windows on the drawing canvas are ignored; only click-then-click works.
labels.root_cause: The canvas only handled clicks, so a press that moved before release was treated as a drag and ignored.

labels.symptom: On a Mac, pressing the delete key does not delete the selected objects.
labels.root_cause: The Mac delete key sends Backspace, but only forward Delete was mapped to erasing the selection.

labels.symptom: CI workflows show Node 20 deprecation warnings.
labels.root_cause: The workflows pin GitHub Actions versions that run on the deprecated Node 20 runtime.

labels.symptom: No RISC-V Linux packages (deb, rpm, tar.gz) are published for releases.
labels.root_cause: The release workflow has no riscv64 cross-compile and packaging job.

labels.symptom: The app is not listed in the Omarchy app catalog.
labels.root_cause: There is no omastore.toml manifest.
